The addressing prefix is the whole difference — "alexanarch" is a coined name with no prior occupant, "crimson hexagon" has several. Card 3 is the Sappho Room Liquidation Diagnostic, which describes the pathway "from classical reception through the Crimson Hexagon to AI Overview/SGE summarization" — the archive’s own account of the route being retrieved by a system at the end of that route.
